name: Psion
source:
"I hope today's performance... makes it all worth your while."

A multi-talented artist with perfect skills and deadly charm.
Graceful and gentle in public, he reveals unrestrained dominance and possessiveness toward those close to him.
Although it seems he forced Somer to stay by his side through a binding contract, their fates were intertwined long, long ago...

Zodiac: Gemini
Animal Aspect: Octopus
Hobby: Freediving

[From [url=https://www.godly-love.com/en/]website[/url]]
